title: Diataxis documentation types v1.0
description: Constrains `type` to the four Diataxis forms. Vocabulary only: `type` is not required, so this schema checks that a type is *legitimate*, not that one is present. Stack it with a schema that requires `type` (such as google:okf:0.1) to get both. See https://diataxis.fr/

type.description: Which of the four Diataxis forms this page is. `tutorial` is learning-oriented, `how-to` is task-oriented, `reference` is information-oriented, and `explanation` is understanding-oriented.
